# governova-types (Python)

Generated Pydantic v2 models for the Governova compiled constitutional index.

**Do not edit by hand.** This package is generated by `governova-codegen` from the
schema source of truth at `scripts/governova_compile/schema.py`. Run:

```bash
uv run governova-codegen
```

The TypeScript equivalent lives at `platform/shared/types-ts/`.
